Collect {{lothlorien:rule/dew-drops}} drops from dewy Mallorn Leaf Carpet or Mallorn Blossom. Dew forms late at night and early in the morning (time {{lothlorien:rule/dew-start}} until before {{lothlorien:rule/dew-end}}) under Mallorn foliage near players. Visible dew remains collectible until it dries.
